Title: Rotisserie-Style Chicken Gyros with Homemade Tzatziki
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 30 ml | extra virgin olive oil |  | 000379
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 1 tsp | dried oregano |  | 000257
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 0.5 tsp | dried thyme |  | 000258
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 0.5 tsp | dried basil |  | 000256
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 1 tsp | Garlic Powder |  | 000643
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 1 tsp | Ground Onion |  | 000644
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 1 tsp | kosher salt |  | 000293
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 0.5 tsp | ground black pepper |  | 000285
- Tzatziki Sauce | 250 g | greek yogurt |  | 000206
- Tzatziki Sauce | 1 tsp | dill |  | 000249
- Warm Pita Bread | 4 g | pita |  | 000340
- Warm Pita Bread | 15 ml | olive oil |  | 000378
- Vegetable Garnishes | 2 units | Roma tomatoes, chopped |  | IMP-6d4cd7
- Vegetable Garnishes | 1 unit | red onion, medium, diced |  | IMP-fa00e5
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 600 g | chicken breast |  | 000044
- Rotisserie-Style Chicken | 1 units | lemon |  | 000130
- Tzatziki Sauce | 1 unit | Cucumber |  | 000642
- Tzatziki Sauce | 2 unit | garlic |  | 000112
- Tzatziki Sauce | 1 units | lemon |  | 000130

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Rotisserie-Style Chicken | Prep |  | Flag: Raw Meat Handling. Wash hands and surfaces after contact. Slice the chicken breasts into very thin 1cm wide strips.
2. Tzatziki Sauce | Prep |  | Grate the cucumber using a box grater. Wrap the pulp in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out all excess moisture.
3. Warm Pita Bread | Prep |  | Lightly brush both sides of each pita bread with olive oil.
4. Vegetable Garnishes | Prep |  | Wash the Roma tomatoes and chop them into uniform cubes.
5. Rotisserie-Style Chicken | Prep |  | In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, thyme, basil, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
6. Tzatziki Sauce | Prep |  | Mince the garlic cloves and finely chop the fresh dill.
7. Warm Pita Bread | Cook |  | Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
8. Vegetable Garnishes | Prep |  | Peel the red onion and slice it into thin half-moons for a milder bite.
9. Rotisserie-Style Chicken | Prep |  | Toss the chicken strips in the marinade until fully coated, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
10. Tzatziki Sauce | Cook |  | In a small bowl, blend the Greek yogurt with the squeezed cucumber, garlic, lemon juice, and dill.
11. Warm Pita Bread | Cook |  | Toast each pita for 1 minute per side until they are soft, warm, and have light golden spots.
12. Vegetable Garnishes | Serve |  | Arrange the tomatoes and onions on a platter to be added to the gyros during final assembly.
13. Rotisserie-Style Chicken | Cook |  | Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place a wire roasting rack over a foil-lined baking sheet.
14. Tzatziki Sauce | Serve |  | Season with a pinch of salt to taste and chill in the refrigerator until ready for use.
15. Warm Pita Bread | Serve |  | Stack the pitas and wrap them in a clean towel to keep them soft and steam slightly before serving.
16. Rotisserie-Style Chicken | Cook |  | Arrange the marinated chicken strips in a single layer on the rack to allow air circulation, simulating a rotisserie environment.
17. Rotisserie-Style Chicken | Cook |  | Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 74°C internal temperature and the edges are slightly charred.
18. Rotisserie-Style Chicken | Serve |  | Remove from the oven and let the meat rest for 5 minutes before assembling the gyros.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Place a wire roasting rack over a foil-lined baking sheet.
Slice {i9} into very thin strips, 1 cm wide. Wash hands and surfaces after touching the raw meat.
steps.done_when: Strips are thin and even, about 1 cm wide

steps.text: In a large bowl, juice {i10} and whisk it together with {i1}, {i2}, {i3}, {i4}, {i6}, {i5}, {i7} and {i8}.
steps.done_when: The marinade is well combined and the herbs are evenly spread

steps.text: Toss the chicken strips in the marinade until fully coated, cover the bowl and refrigerate.
steps.done_when: Every strip is coated in marinade

steps.text: Arrange the marinated chicken strips in a single layer on the rack, so the air can circulate like in a rotisserie.
steps.done_when: A single layer with space between the strips

steps.text: Roast the chicken for 20-25 minutes.
steps.done_when: The chicken reaches 74°C inside and the edges are slightly charred

steps.text: Remove the chicken from the oven and let the meat rest.
Grate {i13} using a box grater. Wrap the pulp in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out all excess moisture.
steps.done_when: The pulp is dry and no more liquid comes out

steps.text: Mince {i14} and finely chop {i12}.
In a small bowl, juice {i15} and blend {i11} with the squeezed cucumber, the garlic, the lemon juice and the dill.
Season the tzatziki with a pinch of salt to taste and chill in the refrigerator until ready for use.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Lightly brush both sides of each pita bread with {i17}, using {i16} in total.
steps.done_when: Both sides are lightly coated in oil

steps.text: Toast each pita for 1 minute per side.
steps.done_when: Soft, warm, with light golden spots

steps.text: Stack the pitas and wrap them in a clean towel to keep them soft and let them steam slightly.
steps.done_when: The pitas are soft and steamy

steps.text: Wash {i18} and chop them into uniform cubes.
Peel {i19} and slice it into thin half-moons for a milder bite.
Arrange the tomatoes and onions on a platter to be added to the gyros during final assembly.
Fill the warm pitas with the rested chicken, tzatziki, tomatoes and red onion, and serve right away.

recipe.chef_note: Slice the chicken evenly so all strips roast at the same pace, and squeeze the cucumber really dry so the tzatziki stays thick.  Wash hands and surfaces after handling raw chicken.
